THE NODE'S SEMANTICS ARE VINDICATED AND MEASURABLE. pSMAD1/5 is directly measured as a time-resolved PATHWAY-ACTIVITY state in primary human endometrial stromal cells and is a different measurement from BMP2 ligand abundance; it rises progressively with EPC in normal cells and is blunted in endometriosis. SMAD1/5 siRNA CAUSALLY impairs decidualization - IGFBP1 and WNT4 significantly downregulated - so the state is functionally necessary and not a relabelling of a marker. BMP2 add-back rescues decidualization in patient-derived 2D cultures and 3D assembloids. The EPC stimulus matches the model's three stromal inputs. This also CORROBORATES U4B-DRREF-001 on BMP -> WNT4 by an independent route, and corroborates the BMP -> FOXO1 link (FOXO signalling is enriched among genes downregulated by SMAD1/5 knockdown).
what_is_NOT_supported: THE DETERMINANT DTR007 ASKED FOR. This is the paper most likely to have supplied it and it does not. In the one PHYSIOLOGICAL comparison the study makes - endometriosis versus normal - BMP2 transcript induction and pSMAD1/5 fall TOGETHER (Fig 3B/C against Fig 3D), which is co-movement, not dissociation. BMP receptors and antagonists are named only in the Discussion as literature context (BMPR2 as a GWAS risk locus; mouse ACVR2A and BMPR2 studies) and ARE NOT MEASURED HERE. The only dissociation in the paper is SMAD1/5 siRNA - a laboratory construct, which is precisely the section 5(2) exclusion that already blocks PC6-b and TI009, not a physiological state ADOC varies. ALSO: the repository records no endometriosis stratification for the ADOC donors, so the one disease-state contrast the paper offers has no ADOC image.
